title: Personalweather Metric1 Hour-of-Day Pattern

spl:
index=personal sourcetype=personalweather:metric1

description: Shows which hours of the day personalweather metric1 (1) events most often occur for each source.
value: Hour-of-day patterns reveal routine anchors, timezone drift, and automation misfires.

visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of events by hour.
grandmaExplanation: It scores what time of day your personalweather metric1 (1) feed is busiest and when it goes quiet.
